requirement: Identify the study as developing or evaluating a prediction model, the target population, and the outcome
evidence: Title identifies a re-analysis of a benchmark rather than model development; the study evaluates measurement properties, not a model for deployment. Deviation is deliberate and stated in the study-type box.

requirement: Structured summary of objectives, methods, results, conclusions
evidence: Report abstract: background (literature survey), objective, methods, results per mechanism, conclusions.

requirement: Explain the medical context and rationale, including why the model is needed
evidence: Section 1, with the clinical context and the benchmark-quality rationale.

requirement: Specify the study objectives, including whether development or evaluation
evidence: Section 2: three mechanisms as primary objectives, four supporting questions.

requirement: Describe the source of data and rationale
evidence: Section 3.1, including the provenance contradiction and its consequences.

requirement: Describe eligibility criteria and setting
evidence: Sections 3.1 and 3.3. The released file documents no eligibility criteria, and the provenance check shows the stated setting is unverified. Reported as a limitation rather than resolved.

requirement: Describe any data pre-processing, including handling of missing data
evidence: Sections 3.2, 3.4 and 4.4; fold-wise median imputation. Section 5.15 additionally audits the imputation performed by the data provider before release.

requirement: Define the outcome, how and when measured
evidence: Section 3.3 and limitation 9: the outcome is CKD status as labelled; chronicity cannot be verified from a cross-sectional record.

requirement: Define all predictors, how and when measured
evidence: src/ckd/features/configs.py: one VariableSpec per column with tier and rationale; 10 flagged uncertain, of which 2 are resolved in section 5.15.

requirement: Explain how study size was arrived at
evidence: Section 3.3: fixed by the released file; events per predictor reported (2.88) against Riley et al. See limitation 1.

requirement: Describe how missing data were handled
evidence: Fold-wise median imputation inside training folds only; verified by TestNoPreprocessingOnFullData.

requirement: Describe model type, building procedure, and validation
evidence: Sections 4.2 and 4.3: 6 model families, repeated nested stratified CV (5 outer x 4 inner, 5 repeats).

requirement: Describe how class imbalance was addressed
evidence: Not addressed by resampling, deliberately: imbalance is mild (64/36) and synthetic oversampling at n=200 would manufacture structure. A test forbids SMOTE-style methods.

requirement: Specify the output of the model (e.g. predicted probability)
evidence: Predicted probability; calibration reported in section 5.6 including non-identified slopes.

requirement: Specify all measures used to assess model performance
evidence: Section 4.5: discrimination, classification at prespecified and screening thresholds, calibration (slope, intercept, Brier, ECE), net benefit (exploratory).

requirement: Describe any model updating or recalibration
evidence: Sections 4.5 and 5.6: none / Platt / isotonic, each fitted inside training folds only.

requirement: Describe any assessment of fairness or subgroup performance
evidence: Section 5.5 reports stage-based subgroup performance. Demographic subgroup analysis is impossible: the file carries no sex, ethnicity or socioeconomic variables. Limitation 7 states this as a reason for caution.

requirement: Describe methods used to interpret the model
evidence: Section 5.7 (permutation and SHAP importance with stability statistics) and 5.12 (EBM shape functions with a documented suppression term).

requirement: Describe the flow of participants and their characteristics
evidence: Sections 3.3 to 3.5, figure E1, table 00.

requirement: Report the final model and its specification
evidence: Sections 5.9 and 5.10 with table 16; the prespecified rule's pick is reported alongside an explicit argument for not endorsing it.

requirement: Report performance with uncertainty intervals
evidence: Sections 5.2 to 5.4 and 5.8; patient-level stratified bootstrap, 2000 resamples.

requirement: Report results of any model updating
evidence: Section 5.6, calibration method comparison.

requirement: Give an overall interpretation in context of objectives and evidence
evidence: Section 6.

requirement: Discuss limitations, including non-representativeness and missing data
evidence: Section 7: 13 limitations, several quantified rather than asserted.

requirement: Discuss usability in clinical practice and implications
evidence: Section 8 and the study-type box: the work makes no deployment claim and states why the sample cannot support one.

requirement: State where data can be accessed
evidence: Section 9 and README; the analysed file is CC BY 4.0, checksummed, never modified.

requirement: State where code can be accessed
evidence: The repository is the artefact; every number is generated by scripts/ from data/.

requirement: State sources of funding
evidence: No external funding; recorded so the omission is visible rather than accidental.

requirement: Declare conflicts of interest
evidence: None.

requirement: State whether a protocol or analysis plan exists
evidence: The analysis design (seed, folds, thresholds, selection rule) is fixed in config/experiment.yaml and was not changed after results were seen; analyses added later are labelled EXPLORATORY and post hoc. No public preregistration exists.
